description: If each set in a natural-number-indexed family has an injective encoding, its displayed least-index encoding into natural-number pairs is injective.
signature:

  (e : (n : ℕ) → ↑(A n) → ℕ) (he : ∀ (n : ℕ), Function.Injective (e n)) :
  Function.Injective (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.unionCode A e)
